publication_revisions.abstract: Supernova SN2025gvs was first reported on 05/04/2025 on the Transient Name Server, TNS#251047. Located at RA=15:50:23.398 Dec=+25:55:10.03, and classified on 06/04/2025 as a type II, with early similarities to type IIb or type IIP. Using the e-MERLIN radio interferometer, we made observations centred on the reported location, with a total time on target of 04:21:26 (hh:mm:ss), using the C-band receivers at a centre frequency of 6.3 GHz. We report no radio source within 5 arcseconds of the reported location, with a 3-sigma RMS of 99 microJy/beam, consistent with a non-detection at this time.
